card: A check-in becomes a rope you can see.
title: HabitForge and the visible rope
intro: HabitForge makes consistency visible as a rope. Each check-in changes it; a gap changes it too.

sections.heading: What is the rope for?
sections.body: It turns repeated check-ins into a rope you can look at.

sections.heading: What changes with a check-in?
sections.body: A check-in thickens the rope; a gap leaves a visible fray.

sections.heading: Can other people take part?
sections.body: There are friends, challenges and a leaderboard — and a way to leave it.

sections.heading: Where does HabitForge fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell lets a record have gaps without turning them into a verdict. HabitForge makes the pattern of check-ins visible as a rope.
